title: Canadian scientists in the legacy program

tellings.quote: because Canadian scientists have been and are involved in the legacy program.

plain: Scientists from Canada have taken part, and still take part, in the "legacy program", the name used for a secret effort said to recover and study craft that were not built by people. The investigative journalist Ross Coulthart says so, passing on what he has been told by sources. If true, it would mean the effort is not only American.
